Maya Patel: Hi @People Ops — I'm planning to relocate my homebase from London to Barcelona around Jul 10. Can someone outline immediate steps for payroll, WFH stipend proration, and whether my move could create tax or registration issues for Redwood?
People Ops: Congrats Maya! :tada: Quick steps below, full checklist after.
People Ops: 1) Fill the Homebase Change form: https://redwoodinternal/forms/homebase-change (do ASAP).
People Ops: 2) Upload/DM the local docs once you have them (NIE/ID, bank IBAN, proof of address / empadronamiento). Payroll timelines matter.
Payroll-EU-Bot: Automated note — vendor: GlobalPay EU. Cutoff to switch payroll for July run: Jun 20. To guarantee July payroll on Spanish payroll, send docs by Jun 10. Required docs:
```
- Passport copy
- NIE or Spanish ID when issued
- Local bank (IBAN/BIC)
- Empadronamiento or rental agreement
```
People Ops: WFH stipend: prorated using a 30-day month divisor. If your move date is Jul 10, July stipend = (days before move still on UK payroll + days after on ES payroll) prorated. Note: stipend currency follows payroll currency for each run.
Diego M.: Curious: will Redwood need to register a Spanish entity if we have a single headcount? I do some contracting for Spanish customers, will that change anything?
Legal-Team: Short answer: not necessarily. Entity registration depends on aggregate activities, local contracting, and whether you create a permanent establishment. Single remote headcount usually doesn't force registration, but if you perform sales, contract negotiation, or hire local contractors it can change. We'll run a nexus assessment based on role and customer interactions.
Benefits-Broker: Health & social: Spain requires registration to social security once on Spanish payroll. That typically happens at payroll start. We can help with enrollment; empadronamiento speeds things up. For short-term transitional coverage, ask about private bridging insurance.
Maya Patel: For the stipend, will the amount change when moving to EUR? Is there a payback or adjustment if currency swings?
People Ops: Stipend amounts are set in local currency bands. When payroll transitions, the stipend will be paid in GBP on UK payroll runs and in EUR after switch. We don't retroactively recalculate prior stipends for FX fluctuations. If you have a strong preference (one-off) for payment currency during transition, add it to your ticket.
Maya Patel: What about final UK payslip timing — any chance of double taxation for the month of move?
Payroll-EU-Bot: Note on final runs: sometimes we issue a final UK run and start Spanish payroll the following month. Tax residency can be affected by days in country; we recommend consulting Personal Tax Advisor. Redwood will provide payroll docs but not tax filing advice.
People Ops: Action items for Maya: 1) Submit form, 2) DM docs to People Ops / GlobalPay portal, 3) CC your manager and tag Legal if your role includes local sales. We'll open a ticket and confirm exact payroll cutover dates.
Maya Patel: Thanks — filling form now. Also requesting relocation assistance info (temporary housing). Will email relocation@redwood.com
Diego M.: Noted — this thread was super helpful. :thumbsup:
People Ops: We'll follow up with a ticket number in 24h and attach a short PDF with country-specific tips (Spain). Ping us if anything blocks.
